# OctopusGarage

> Compact open-source tools for durable AI-assisted work: agent control, local automation, private knowledge, and browser-native products.

## Links

- [Website](https://octopusgarage.github.io/)
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/OctopusGarage)
- [Full AI-readable profile](https://octopusgarage.github.io/llms-full.txt)
- [Project data](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects.json)

## Public Projects

- [tmux-claude-bot](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/tmux-claude-bot.md): control Claude Code and OpenAI Codex agents from Telegram, Feishu/Lark, a CLI, or a TUI.
- [telegram-bridge](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/telegram-bridge.md): bridge Telegram messages into tmux and stream pane output back to chat.
- [alcove](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/alcove.md): local-first personal memory for agent workflows.
- [clipsmith](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/clipsmith.md): capture posts, articles, media, and OCR into portable local bundles.
- [english-pilot](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/english-pilot.md): English conversation gate, coaching assistant, and review system for AI workflows.
- [fluent-frame](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/fluent-frame.md): local-first Chrome extension for bilingual YouTube subtitles and English learning notes.
- [phronesis](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/phronesis.md): practical-wisdom workspace for applying philosophical thought modules with local AI agents.
- [git-auto-sync](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/git-auto-sync.md): auto-sync local repositories with AI-assisted commits, scheduling, and notifications.
- [net-auto-switch](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/net-auto-switch.md): keep macOS WiFi and Clash Verge proxy nodes healthy with measured network checks.
- [envsentinel](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/envsentinel.md): audit local environment signals for AI coding CLIs.
- [mesh-talk](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/mesh-talk.md): serverless encrypted LAN messenger.
- [octopusgarage-skills](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/octopusgarage-skills.md): practical agent skills for OctopusGarage workflows.
- [bracket-guess](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/bracket-guess.md): predict brackets and export shareable posters.
- [mbti-lab](https://octopusgarage.github.io/projects/mbti-lab.md): bilingual MBTI test with shareable results.

## About

OctopusGarage connects recurring workflows around long-running AI coding agents: keeping sessions reachable, maintaining local machines, preserving source material and private memory, supporting learning and judgment loops, communicating on local networks, and publishing small browser-native products. Public listings intentionally exclude private and archived repositories.
